limitations: WEB-02 owns the wide and compact desktop search/filter toolbar only. The detail inspector remains WEB-03, dry-run WEB-04, approvals WEB-05, run views WEB-06, narrow tree WEB-07, and complete accessibility acceptance WEB-08.

The recent-run filter is disabled until a valid status summary exists. A run-filter deep link retains its URL state but shows an explicit loading or unavailable state; a missing or failed status response is never presented as never_run.

Browser evidence uses the real production Vite preview and real hierarchy API, with a deterministic same-origin status route so ETag, 304, polling, and run-state membership are reproducible even when a fresh local runtime store is unavailable.

The strict 43-ID status binding is intentionally catalog-version-specific. An authorized catalog inventory change must update the hierarchy and WEB-02 evidence together rather than silently accepting partial or reordered runtime status.

DEL-07 still owns the generated TypeScript API client and drift gate. WEB-02 validates the status transport from unknown through a narrow endpoint-specific normalizer without claiming generated-client parity.
